effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.) Then, trash 2 cards in your hand. If [Garurumon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, gain 1 memory.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon with [Garurumon] or [Omnimon] in its name would be deleted in battle, by returning 2 non-Digi-Egg cards from your trash to the bottom of the deck, prevent that deletion.
